cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.15)
project(test_iio C)

# Upstream libiio 0.25 does not install(EXPORT) a CMake config package —
# it only ships a pkg-config file (libiio.pc). So consume it the way
# upstream intends: via PkgConfig IMPORTED targets generated by Conan's
# PkgConfigDeps from the recipe's pkg_config_name property.
find_package(PkgConfig REQUIRED)
pkg_check_modules(LIBIIO REQUIRED IMPORTED_TARGET libiio)
message(STATUS "libiio version from pkg-config: ${LIBIIO_VERSION}")

add_executable(test_iio test_iio.c)
target_link_libraries(test_iio PkgConfig::LIBIIO)

enable_testing()
add_test(NAME test_iio COMMAND test_iio)
